description: AliExpress partner product lookup via official signed TOP APIs. Affiliate search/detail need developer AppKey and AppSecret but no user Session; dropship product/SKU reads are separate OAuth-gated APIs. No valid partner app credentials or dropship authorization were provided, so no live product result is claimed.

capabilities.title: Search affiliate-eligible product records with distinct sale/list/app/target prices
capabilities.blocker: The adapter is implemented, but independent live business replay requires the user's registered AliExpress/TOP app_key and app_secret. No placeholder key or documentation demo key is treated as credentials.

capabilities.title: Read affiliate product detail/prices, catalog images/video, seller and positive-review percentage by product ID
capabilities.blocker: Live detail read needs the user's registered AliExpress/TOP app_key and app_secret; these were not supplied. No user Session is required by this Affiliate method.
capabilities.note: Preserves all documented product image URLs, product video URL, seller/store and evaluate_rate. The API does not return structured long description, options, SKU, or stock.

capabilities.title: Search AliExpress social affiliate catalog with bounded USD price ranges
capabilities.blocker: This official API returns locale-formatted price ranges. The implementation currently accepts only the documented en_US/USD form and still requires app_key/app_secret for a live signed request.

capabilities.title: Preserve product gallery images, product video, seller signals, and sourced rating metadata
capabilities.blocker: Local response fixtures cover the documented Affiliate gallery/video/evaluate_rate and Social item_pics/comment_score fields. No valid app credentials were supplied for live replay.
capabilities.note: evaluate_rate is a positive-review percentage; Social comment_score is preserved with its scale unknown. Product item_pics are catalog images, not review photos.

capabilities.title: Read customer review bodies, customer-submitted photos, or overall review count
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The documented Affiliate product query/detail responses provide evaluate_rate; Social item search provides comment_score and semantic recent-comment metadata. None of these methods returns review bodies/photos or an overall review count.

capabilities.title: Read structured description, sale options/SKUs, or inventory from affiliate product calls
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The documented Affiliate query/detail fields contain no long description, option/SKU matrix, availability, or stock. Dropship product and SKU APIs are separately listed as authorization-gated capabilities.

capabilities.title: Read a dropshipper-eligible product using the AliExpress dropship API
capabilities.blocker: Official aliexpress.ds.product.get requires a user-authorized dropshipper Session and API entitlement. No such authorization was supplied or verified.

capabilities.title: Read dropship SKU prices, stock, and listing status
capabilities.blocker: Official aliexpress.offer.ds.product.simplequery requires authorization and is restricted to certain buyers. Affiliate API app credentials do not prove this dropship entitlement.

capabilities.title: Supply an AliExpress/TOP app key and app secret for signed Affiliate reads
capabilities.blocker: Credential material is absent from this task. Runtime configuration must inject it in process memory and must not persist it in Git or receipts.

capabilities.title: User login Session for the documented Affiliate query/search methods
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Official TOP API references mark the Affiliate product query, Affiliate product detail, and social item search methods as not requiring user authorization. Developer AppKey/AppSecret signature remains required.

capabilities.title: Create affiliate links, place orders, or modify partner account state
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The assigned scope is read-only product discovery, detail and price collection. Affiliate link generation, cart/order, signup, and partner-account writes are outside scope.
